name: f3-redirect-server
//: Thin adapter: maps Turborepo's task vocabulary to native Go tooling so the monorepo orchestrates this Go module uniformly. Scripts route through scripts/*.sh wrappers that ignore forwarded args (turbo passes eslint's --cache and vitest's --coverage to every task of that name). No npm deps. Requires the Go toolchain (and Docker for the certstore emulator tests) on the runner.
